screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.title: Super Mario 64 ROM needed
screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.explanation:
Retro64 Plus needs your own Super Mario 64 (USA) ROM, in .z64, .v64 or .n64 format, to play. It is copied into the retro64plus folder; your file is never changed or moved.

Or put the ROM in that folder yourself and press Check Again.
screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.not_found: No Super Mario 64 (USA) ROM found yet.
screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.unsupported: Retro64 Plus can't run on this system
Retro64 Plus plays Super Mario 64 through a native library built for Windows and Linux (64-bit) only, and this is %s. Remove Retro64 Plus from your mods to play Minecraft here.
screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.not_n64_rom: That file isn't a Nintendo 64 ROM.
screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.wrong_rom: That's a Nintendo 64 ROM, but not Super Mario 64 (USA). Only the US version works.
screen.retro64plus.rom_setup.read_error: Couldn't read or copy that file. See the log for details.

retro64plus.configuration.title: Retro64 Plus
retro64plus.configuration.rom_path.descr: Path to your Super Mario 64 (USA) ROM, if you'd rather not copy it into the retro64plus folder. Leave empty to use the folder.
retro64plus.configuration.character.desc: Who you play as. Your Skin is your own skin on a blocky body that moves like Mario. Other players see your choice. The Next Character key (unbound by default) switches in game. A server may allow only some characters.
retro64plus.configuration.music.descript: Plays a Super Mario 64 track while you're Mario. Off by default. Follows the Players volume slider.
retro64plus.configuration.power_meter_al: Keeps Super Mario 64's power meter on screen while you're Mario. Off: as in the game, it slides in when you're hurt or under water and away again at full power.
retro64plus.configuration.power_meter_po: Where Super Mario 64's power meter sits while you're Mario: the top middle of the screen, or left of the hotbar.
retro64plus.configuration.coin_counter_p: Where your coin counter sits: the top-left corner as in Super Mario 64, the top-right corner, or hidden.
retro64plus.configuration.coin_counter_a: Show the coin counter when you're not Mario too.
item.retro64plus.recharge_mushroom.descr: Use it to recharge a cap at once: the one in your other hand, or the first recharging one you carry.
retro64plus.configuration.controller.des: Play Mario with a gamepad, only while you're Mario. Left stick moves, A jumps, B punches, LT or LB is Z, the right stick turns the camera. RT attacks, RB uses, the d-pad picks the hotbar slot. Controllable and Controlify pause while you're Mario.
retro64plus.configuration.controller_dea: How far a stick must move before it counts.
retro64plus.configuration.controller_loo: How fast the right stick turns the camera.
